RAVINDRA DHARPURE SENIOR BUSINESS ANALYST | BANKING & COMPLIANCE IT

Pune, Maharashtra | 8605178093 | ravindra.dharpure1@gmail.com

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Business Analyst with 8+ years of experience in the IT industry, including extensive experience in Banking and Financial Services (BFSI). Experienced in Corporate Banking, Cross-Border Payments, Remittance Applications, Loan Origination Systems (LOS), and payment processing solutions. Strong experience in requirements elicitation, stakeholder management, business process modeling, BRD/FRD, user stories, use cases, API analysis, data mapping, UAT, and Agile delivery. Strong domain knowledge of SWIFT Messaging, ISO 20022, MT-to-MX migration, AML, Sanctions Screening, payment processing, clearing and settlement, ACH, and Straight Through Processing (STP).

CORE SKILLS

Business Analysis: Requirements Gathering, Requirements Elicitation, Stakeholder Management, Impact Analysis, Gap Analysis, Business Process Modeling, BRD, FRD, User Stories, Use Cases, Acceptance Criteria, UAT, Defect Management, Change Management Banking & Compliance: Corporate Banking, Cross-Border Payments, Remittance, Loan Origination, AML, Sanctions Screening, Regulatory Requirements, Payment Processing, Clearing, Settlement, ACH, STP Payments & Messaging: SWIFT MT, ISO 20022 MX, MT101, MT103, MT202, pacs.008, pacs.009, camt, pain, MT-to-MX Migration, Message Mapping Technical & Tools: SQL, API Analysis, Swagger, Data Mapping, Jira, Confluence, Power BI, Advanced Excel, Figma, Draw.io, MS Office, Agile/Scrum

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Senior Business Analyst — Incube8 Engineering, Pune, Maharashtra | Client - Nedbank | Jan 2024 – Aug 2026 -

Gather and analyze business requirements and prepare BRD, FRD, User Stories, Use Cases, and process flow diagrams.

Collaborate with stakeholders, Compliance, Forex, and Payment Operations teams to define payment processing and

regulatory requirements.

Perform data mapping and gap analysis for SWIFT MT101 and MT103 payment messages and support integration with

Payment Gateway systems.

Analyze APIs using Swagger and coordinate integrations with Customer Information System (CIS), Forex, Compliance

Screening, OTP Gateway, and SWIFT/BIC lookup services.

Support AML, Sanctions Screening, and regulatory compliance requirements for international payments.

Facilitate SIT and UAT, prepare test scenarios, validate defects, and obtain business sign-offs.

Participate in Agile ceremonies, requirement walkthroughs, stakeholder discussions, and change management activities.

Contribute to improving payment processing efficiency, reducing transaction failures, and enhancing STP rates.

Business Analyst — VSM Infotech Pvt Ltd, Bengaluru, Karnataka | Client - ACLEDA Bank | Feb 2018 – Dec 2023

Worked as a Business Analyst on a Digital Loan Origination System (LOS), automating the end-to-end loan application

process for Personal, Vehicle, Home, and Business Loans.

Gathered and analyzed business requirements and prepared BRD/FRD, User Stories, Use Cases, and process flows.

Collaborated with Credit, Risk, Compliance, Operations, and IT teams to define lending rules and regulatory requirements.

Supported integrations with Customer Information System, Credit Bureau, KYC, AML, Fraud Detection, Bank Statement

Analysis, and Core Banking systems.

Performed API analysis, data mapping, UAT coordination, defect management, and stakeholder communication to support

loan processing, approval, and disbursement workflows.

KEY PROJECTS

Remittance Application – Cross-Border Payments | Senior Business Analyst | Jan 2024 – Present

Worked on a cross-border Remittance Application for Nedbank of South Africa, enabling secure international money transfers. Supported payment processing, SWIFT message mapping, compliance screening, API integrations, SIT/UAT, and regulatory requirements.

Digital Loan Origination System (LOS) | Business Analyst | Feb 2018 – Dec 2023

Worked on a digital LOS supporting Personal, Vehicle, Home, and Business Loans. Supported lending rules, compliance requirements, KYC/AML integrations, credit bureau integration, fraud detection, bank statement analysis, UAT, and end-to-end loan workflows.

EDUCATION

Master in Technology — Nagpur University | 2014

Bachelor in Engineering — Nagpur University | 2009

TARGET ROLE

Business Analyst | Senior Business Analyst | Banking IT | Compliance IT | BAPM | Payments | Regulatory Change
